Times shown are upstream departures. No printed clock for this stop in the official brochure.
Offline timetable and map for the city buses of El Puerto de Santa María.
The map shows lines 1–7 and the stops that have a position in the snapshot.
A filled navy dot is a stop with its own printed clock. A white dot with a navy edge has no printed clock.
Tap a stop for the timetable sheet.
Schedules, map, and holidays are in the app. It does not download them.
Departures use your phone\'s date and time.
A stop with a printed clock shows that clock.

A stop with no printed clock shows the official time from an earlier stop on the same line, or from a later printed stop when the sheet says so. That time belongs to the named stop. It is not an arrival estimate. Allow time to walk.
Some clocks are printed as approximate. The sheet marks those.
Saturday uses the Saturday timetable. Sunday uses the Sunday and holiday timetable.
A holiday from the bundled calendar uses that Sunday and holiday timetable on any day of the week, including Saturday.
Line 6 does not run on Saturday, Sunday, or a holiday. Line 7 does not run on Sunday or a holiday.
No live positions and no traffic delays.
No trip planner and no transfers.
Clocks: timetable at https://bus.elpuertodesantamaria.es/. Season 31 August 2026–30 August 2027.

This application is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the City Council of El Puerto de Santa María or any government entity. It is not an official government service.
Official timetables and service announcements can be consulted at https://bus.elpuertodesantamaria.es/horarios.html.
This app provides an intuitive, offline-friendly interface to easily check urban bus routes, stops, and scheduled departure times in El Puerto de Santa María.

The schedules in this app are the published winter timetable bundled here. They are theoretical. The operator may change the official timetable without notice. This app keeps the bundled copy until a new version is installed.
